name: Founding Client Cohort 01
purpose: Validate the complete service experience and Blueprint usefulness before scale.
serviceModel: High-touch hybrid: secure digital intake + private intelligence + human research/QA + private PDF delivery + 30/60/90 follow-up.
successEvidence: Customer completes intake without material confusion.
Blueprint is individualized enough that the customer recognizes themselves.
Top opportunities contain actionable market/income/start evidence.
Customer can select at least one bounded experiment without being prescribed a path.
Payment, entitlement, data, QA and delivery operations work without manual security workarounds.
Feedback identifies what is worth improving before broader launch.
